thepale.configuration.title: The Pale

Ride the Frost Colossus for 500 blocks

message.thepale.colossus.event.end: The Frost Colossus has gone back into the Pale.
message.thepale.colossus.crystals: Hit with the pickaxe: mine the diamonds

message.thepale.colossus.crystals_mined: The crystals broke off: the diamonds are yours
advancements.thepale.colossus.diamonds.d: Mine the diamond crystals off the Frost Colossus with a pickaxe
message.thepale.colossus.shore: The colossus stops at the shore: it won't carry you out into the Pale. Get down when you're ready
